headline: Spanberger intervenes in case to decide fate of Dominion-NextEra merger
summary: Gov. Abigail Spanberger announced Thursday that she will formally become a party in the case before the State Corporation Commission that is weighing whether to allow a proposed merger between Dominion Energy and Florida-based NextEra.
